payload.feature:
This worktree carries decision 0041 rulings 4 and 5 as delivered by run decision-0041-docs-decisions-004-69a44983 (commit 38d8d3b on top of main f0d5e50). That run's implement seat reported `blocked` on a contradiction its review had also named as HIGH, and the run stopped at IMPL-BLOCKED. This slice resolves the contradiction by the reading below, answers every review finding, and ships on top of the existing commit; read docs/decisions/0041-one-office-per-seat.md and docs/decisions/0042-the-council-is-brokkrs-the-dialect-is-the-realms.md first, both accepted.

The contradiction, quoted from the seats: "accepted ruling 2 classifies chief-architect design synthesis as a gate, and the shipped SDD charters require that step to create and commit four design artifacts; accepted ruling 4 forbids every gate from editing or committing." And: "recipes/sdd and recipes/sdd-paranoid park at design with GATE-MOVED-HEAD on every successful design. bundle.rs contains_gate_class marks the whole design sequence as gate-bearing because the chief step is class gate."

The reading, grounded in decision 0042 rather than invented: 0042 ruling 6 says "the chief authors the specify and design artifacts and commits exactly those" and "no gate touches an artifact (0041 ruling 4)", and 0042 rulings 2 to 4 give every artifact phase a boxed validate step as its judge. An office that authors an artifact is a work seat; the judge of that artifact is the validator, a gate. So the `chief` step of the design sequence in recipes/sdd/bundle.json (and every recipe that copies it) is `"class": "work"`, and the `speckit-check` validate step that follows it stays the phase's gate; the class column of 0041 ruling 2's table named the hiring grade, and the chief keeps its chain (fable at max, then opus at max) and the judges list still binds it through the adapter because the chain names judges anyway. `triage` stays a gate: it writes only the run-local framing under .forge/, which is gitignored and never moves the head, and it rules. Record the reading as a dated addendum at the end of decision 0041 — "## Addendum — 2026-09-04, the enactment's reading, operator ruling pending" — three sentences stating the contradiction, the reading, and that 0042 ruling 6 is its ground; do not edit any ruling's text. The engine's head check then holds for every gate-class site exactly as ruling 4 says, and the sdd recipes run: add the test the review asked for — a real gate-bearing sequence driven through the engine (not has_gate set by hand), asserting a work-class chief that commits passes and a gate-class step that commits parks GATE-MOVED-HEAD — and pin in the roster test that has_gate is true for review, verify and ship and false for implement and for the design sequence whose final judging step is the boxed validator.

The review's other findings, quoted and to be fixed:
- MEDIUM, security: "IMPL-OK-DOCS-RETURN skips verify for any returning implement whose delta is docs-only, but engine.rs exposes fixes_docs_only on every second-or-later implement visit regardless of what sent it back. After VERIFY-FAIL -> implement, or the IMPL-BROKEN-ONCE self-loop, a docs-only commit routes straight to review." Expose `fixes_docs_only` on implement's ruling only when the return came from review (the fold knows the returning decision's `from`), and add the verify-fail-then-docs-only table and engine tests that prove the rule does not fire.
- LOW: "A review `clean` carrying spec_defect: true takes REVIEW-CLEAN to ship; the decision says a review carrying it returns to the chief." Make the sdd table read `spec_defect` on `clean` as well as on `residual` — a clean with a spec defect returns to design under the same visits bound — and pin it.
- LOW: pin has_gate against the shipped bundles as above.
- INFO: engine.rs:96's comment says the two head observations are journaled as checkpoints and they are not; either journal them as `effect/checkpointed` facts, which is the honest form, or correct the comment; engine/tests.rs ~3203's comment about which phases carry a head is stale — fix it. The GATE-MOVED-HEAD reason packs JSON into the indeterminate reason string; if a typed field is available without a contract change, use it, otherwise leave the packed form and say so in a comment.

Everything else 38d8d3b established stays: the read-only reviewer charters, `fixes_applied` gone from every shipped recipe, the return edges with their bounds, `spec_defect` in the vocabulary, `oversized` on the implementer, the witness and compose pins re-pinned with reasons wherever they move again.

Constraints: the exact coverage gate (scripts/coverage-exact.sh, run with stdin closed: </dev/null) must stay at literal 100%; clippy -D warnings and fmt must stay clean; cargo test --workspace green; contracts/, fixtures/ and policy/phase-machine.json are read-only and this slice needs no contract change; the decision index docs/decisions/README.md must keep every row main carries in number order (an addendum changes no status); do not name the private neighbours in prose; keep the CLI list "claude, codex or dsh" whenever a list of harnesses appears; commit in the repository's style on top of 38d8d3b and never push.

result.notes: Recorded the decision 0041 addendum; made the SDD chief a work step and its boxed validator the gate; enforced HEAD stability at gate sequence-step scope; restricted implement docs-only bypass to review returns; routed clean spec defects back to design; added table, engine, roster, coverage, and digest pins. Formatting, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, and literal 100% exact coverage all pass. Committed as 9c0288d.

Verified HEAD 9c0288d on fire/0041-edges, clean tree. Step 1: `cargo test --workspace` — every `test result:` line reads ok, 1032 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored across brokkr-bridge (13), brokkr-cli (236 unit + 21 integration binaries incl. machine_proof 56, decisions_index 2, recipes 10, hands 2), brokkr-core (47 unit + differential 3 + fold_test 7 + policy_lint 2), brokkr-protocol (105 + 1 doctest), brokkr-runtime (274 unit + adoption, crucible_review_sequence, frozen_contracts, node_recipe_gates, roster 7, witness_digests 3, wager_parity 3 and the rest), brokkr-store (51 + concurrent_processes), brokkr-view (69). Step 2: `cargo run -p brokkr-cli -- compile --bundle bundles/self` exited 0 and printed the compiled bundle (phases intake/implement/verify/review/ship/done/stop; seats implement/intake/review/ship/verify) with no lint output. Nothing changed, nothing committed.

Reviewed 9c0288d (on top of 38d8d3b, unpushed: no remote branch contains it) read-only against the framing, decision 0041 and 0042 ruling 6. Ran from this seat: cargo fmt --all --check clean; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo test -p brokkr-runtime -p brokkr-core -p brokkr-cli, 44 test binaries all ok (the verify seat ran the full workspace, 1032 passed). scripts/coverage-exact.sh cannot run from a seat; the implementer reports literal 100%, unverified here.

Every finding the prior review raised is answered. HIGH contradiction: recipes/sdd chief is class work, speckit-check is the gate and, being exec, is boxed with hands workspace so it may hold a gate under 0043 ruling 3; sdd-paranoid extends sdd so it inherits the fix; is_gate_class replaces contains_gate_class and the engine guards a sequence per gate step (engine.rs execute_sequence sets active_gate_head at a gate step and finish_gate_head_check compares before the step's terminal event); the new engine test compiles a real mixed sequence from JSON and drives it: a committing work chief passes, a committing gate parks GATE-MOVED-HEAD. The addendum is three sentences, the heading is exact, no ruling text edited, the decision index untouched, and 0042 ruling 6 says what the addendum says it says. MEDIUM docs-only bypass: fixes_docs_only is exposed on implement only when last_decision.from equals the protected phase; engine tests cover the verify-fail return, the review return, and the missing-head cases, and the core table test pins IMPL-OK without the input. LOW clean+spec_defect: REVIEW-CLEAN-SPEC-DEFECT and its exhausted park sit ahead of REVIEW-CLEAN in the sdd table, the only shipped table that names spec_defect, and both arms are pinned. LOW has_gate: roster.rs pins true for review/verify/ship, false for implement and design, and the chief work / speckit-check gate step classes. INFO items: the engine.rs field comment and the tests.rs ruling-1 comment are corrected; the GATE-MOVED-HEAD packed reason is kept with a comment saying why (EffectIndeterminate has only a reason string in the frozen contract; the structured copy rides run/parked).

Residual findings, none fixed by me:

[LOW, security: fail-closed coverage gap] is_gate_class returns true for a panel only when every member is a gate, and PanelMember carries no class at run time, so a panel that mixes a gate member with a work member compiles, gets has_gate false, and its gate member runs with no head check at all; 38d8d3b guarded such a panel whole. No shipped bundle has this shape (every shipped panel is uniformly work or uniformly gate) and the charters still forbid commits, so this is a defense-in-depth hole reachable only by a bundle author, not by a seat result or driver output. Either refuse a mixed panel at compile time, the way refuse_class_without_a_driver refuses a class on a panel, or guard a mixed panel whole and say so in the has_gate doc comment, which today mentions only mixed sequences.

[INFO, test-coverage] speckit-check is the first shipped exec site that runs under the 0043 box; the hands integration test proves brokkr hands exec generically, but nothing drives the sdd design seat's boxed gate end to end, so a box that cannot see the exec driver's staged prompt file or the workdir-relative script path would surface only in a real run.

[INFO, correctness] active_gate_head is not cleared when a gate step's inner run_driver, run_panel or journal_panel_members returns Err; that path aborts drive() so no journal row is affected today, but the field would be stale if the engine were ever reused after such an error.

No injection, secret or journal-tamper path found: head evidence is engine-written; undeclared spec_defect and fixes_docs_only claims are dropped by decide(); the docs class is read at the entry commit; the box narrows what the exec gate can touch relative to the unboxed script it replaces.
